# Copilot repository instructions — Silverspark Compass v1.2
Read root `AGENTS.md`, `docs/stages/INDEX.md`, and the active stage's document. Stage-limited PRs with evidence-based handoff are mandatory. Never skip the S0–S1 human review gates or change the GitHub Pages-only architecture. Keep separate business rules from UI, implement pure TypeScript domain functions with independent tests, and verify subpath navigation, accessibility and privacy. No auto-submission/analytics/remote API. Use `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md` where applicable; avoid contradicting AGENTS.md.
